verdict: Ads were paused for 19 days; restoring spend and attribution is the priority.
narrative: All paid activity stopped on September 17th and remained off for 19 consecutive days, which is why the 28-day totals reflect only the activity from the first part of the window. The 48 leads you received this period came entirely from Meta before that pause, at a cost of $16.20 per lead. Google Ads spent $201 over the same window and recorded zero conversions — conversion tracking on that channel is being repaired now. Campaigns are being brought back live, and the overdue setup work — including attribution fixes, landing pages, and audience tools — is being resolved in parallel so that when spend scales in October, every dollar is measurable.
